context_notes: Two self-inflicted incidents this session, both recorded as blocking anti-patterns in .continue-here.md: a blanket `git checkout -- .` destroyed the owner's uncommitted links.html; and a commit chain ran without gating on the test result, committing once with a failing assertion (amended) and once with 17 suites unable to load (local node_modules pruned by `npm audit fix --omit=dev`; the committed lockfile was correct). The throughline that paid off: verify on the live page, not the server (executing-bundle stamp), and reproduce both directions of a bug before calling it fixed.
